entries.label: Notion
entries.description: Search, read, and update pages and databases in your Notion workspace.

entries.label: GitHub
entries.description: Search code, read and open issues/PRs, and work with repositories.

steps: Go to GitHub, click your profile picture (top right), then Settings.
In the left sidebar, click Developer settings, then OAuth Apps, then New OAuth App.
Application name: anything you like, e.g. "Jarvis". Homepage URL: anything, e.g. http://127.0.0.1.
Authorization callback URL: paste the address shown below exactly.
Click Register application, then click Generate a new client secret.
Copy the Client ID and the new Client Secret and paste them in below.

entries.label: Slack
entries.description: Search and send messages, and read canvases, in your Slack workspace.

guide.note: Slack requires the redirect address to use HTTPS. Jarvis's address is plain HTTP, so Slack's own sign-in step may refuse it — if that happens, this connector can't be completed yet.
steps: Go to api.slack.com/apps, click Create New App, then From scratch. Give it a name and pick your workspace.
In the left sidebar, click OAuth & Permissions, add the address shown below under Redirect URLs, then click Save URLs.
In the left sidebar, click Basic Information — your Client ID and Client Secret are under App Credentials.
Copy both and paste them in below.

entries.label: Google Drive
entries.description: Search, read, and upload files in your Google Drive.

steps: Go to console.cloud.google.com and create or pick a project.
Go to Google Auth Platform, then Branding, and fill in the basic app info if it asks you to.
Go to Google Auth Platform, then Clients, then Create Client. Application type: Web application.
Under Authorized redirect URIs, paste the address shown below exactly.
Click Create, then copy the Client ID and Client Secret and paste them in below.

entries.label: Gmail
entries.description: Read, search, and compose email in your Gmail account.

guide.note: This is a Google Workspace Developer Preview feature, not a finished general-release product yet — Google itself may still change or restrict it.
steps: Go to console.cloud.google.com and create or pick a project.
Go to APIs & Services, then Library, and enable both the "Gmail API" and the "Gmail MCP API".
Go to Google Auth Platform, then Branding, and fill in the basic app info if it asks you to.
Go to Google Auth Platform, then Clients, then Create Client. Application type: Web application.
Under Authorized redirect URIs, paste the address shown below exactly.
Click Create, then copy the Client ID and Client Secret and paste them in below.

entries.label: Higgsfield API
entries.description: Generate images and videos with Higgsfield's models through its developer API, using an API key.

api.keyHint: Paste it in the key-id:key-secret form the Higgsfield console gives you.

operations.name: generate
operations.description: Start a Higgsfield generation and wait for the finished result (image or video URLs). Pass the model id as model, e.g. bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video or higgsfield-ai/soul/v2/standard, and that model's inputs as body, e.g. {"prompt": "...", "duration": 5, "resolution": "720p", "aspect_ratio": "16:9"}. Uses the account's API credits.

body.description: The model's inputs, e.g. {"prompt": "A cinematic scene at sunset", "duration": 5, "resolution": "720p", "aspect_ratio": "16:9"}.

operations.name: get_request_status
operations.description: Check a Higgsfield generation request by its request id, returning its status and, once completed, its result.

request_id.description: The request id a generation returned.

operations.name: cancel_request
operations.description: Cancel a Higgsfield generation request that has not started processing yet.

entries.label: Higgsfield CLI
entries.description: Generate images, videos and audio with the Higgsfield command-line tool installed on this computer, signed in with your Higgsfield account.

commands.name: account_status
commands.description: Show the signed-in Higgsfield account's credit balance and plan.

commands.name: list_models
commands.description: List the image, video, audio and text models Higgsfield offers, with their job type names.

commands.name: model_details
commands.description: Show one model's accepted parameters and defaults, by its job type name.

args.name: job_type
args.description: The model's job type name from list_models, e.g. nano_banana_2 or seedance_2_0.

commands.name: estimate_cost
commands.description: Estimate how many credits a generation would cost, without creating it.

args.name: prompt
args.description: The prompt that would be used.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Create an image or video with a Higgsfield model from a text prompt and wait for the finished result URL(s). Uses the account's credits.

args.name: job_type
args.description: The model's job type name, e.g. nano_banana_2 for an image or seedance_2_0 for a video.

commands.name: get_generation
commands.description: Show one generation job by its id, including its status and result URL(s).

commands.name: list_generations
commands.description: List recent generation jobs on the account.
